overview_prompt:
Create ONE very high quality vertical 9:16 image (1080x1920 composition) as the overall visual concept for a film called "The First Light of the River City". No text anywhere. This is an original Near Eastern Babylonian-inspired FANTASY city, NOT a historical reconstruction. It must look like a real cinematic macro photograph of an exquisitely crafted architectural miniature, physically tangible believable materials, not a flat illustration or generic videogame screenshot.

Composition and stable geography for the later animated film: an oblique elevated camera looking down at roughly 50 degrees, moderately long lens compression. Portrait frame filled with layered city, very little sky. Foreground lower-left: a substantial deep cobalt blue glazed-brick gate with two square crenellated towers, small raised animal reliefs and an open central passage, surrounded by ochre mudbrick city walls. An open gently curving canal passes inward from lower center through dense flat-roofed courtyard houses and palm groves toward the middle-upper area. Upper-right third: the dominant Babylonian rectangular stepped ziggurat, four broad receding terraces, earthen brick, blue glazed accents, a small rectangular blue shrine on its top, no pointed roofs, no Egyptian pyramid silhouette. On the canal-facing side of the ziggurat is an open lower landing terrace with a small bronze beacon bowl; leave a clear aerial approach from the canal to this terrace. A low bridge in the midground connects the two banks. A coherent city extending around these landmarks with variation in building heights, shadowed courtyards, brick stairways, reed awnings, tiny pottery vessels, docks, boats and very sparse tiny inhabitants. Nothing crowded into one central pile.

A single small bronze-green scaled winged courier dragon is flying over the canal in the lower-middle/middle region toward the ziggurat, carrying a tiny amber ember between its front claws; the dragon is a modest-scale secondary focal detail, not a giant foreground creature. Visually coherent anatomy, delicate membrane wings, long neck and small horn crown. Most street lamps unlit, just a few discreet amber points along the canal as hints of the coming light ceremony. No laser lines.

Photographic light: warm late-afternoon sidelight grazing brick edges, still bright enough to read material, cool soft sky fill, clear contact shadows, controlled realistic highlights on blue glaze and bronze, no black crushed shadows. Materials: weathered earthen brick with fine joints and occasional chipped edges, subtle wall-base discoloration, glazed brick with real variation in roughness, flowing canal water with restrained reflection, fibrous palm fronds. Broad shapes, mid-scale construction, fine details all readable. The miniature quality comes from the elevated perspective and selective realistic depth of field: central canal, gate rear and landing-terrace region readable, extreme near edge and far distance gradually soften; do not blur away the city. Elegant tilt-shift look, not a hard horizontal blur stripe. Sharp central architecture without oversharpening or noisy texture. A real built world, not visibly placed on a tabletop or floating cutaway base.

No text, logos, borders, montage, labels or UI. No European castles, gothic towers, tiled pitched roofs, Tudor framing, onion domes, minarets, modern buildings, Egyptian obelisks, giant mountains, giant dunes, cartoon plastic, low-poly blocks, neon bloom, smoke obscuring the buildings. This is a single coherent animation-ready establishing world concept, not a collage.
